Proposition
[Short-time existence for the harmonic map flow] ↗ def:standard-ricci-flow

For every $t_0<T_1$ for which a standard solution is defined on $[0,T_1]$, (18) with $\tilde\rho (\cdot ,t_0)=0$ has a solution on $[t_0,T]$ for some $T>t_0$.
Proof

\sketch Shift $t_0$ to $0$ and iterate the heat-kernel formula

□
